title: Canonical compatible-module fibre product
statement: Let $b:B\to A$ and $q:A'\to A$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, let $N$ be a $B$-module and $M'$ an $A'$-module, and let $\varphi:N\otimes_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}M'\otimes_{A'}A$ be an $A$-linear isomorphism. Tensor products are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Put $R=B\times_A A'=\{(x,y):b(x)=q(y)\}$ with coordinatewise ring operations and $M=M'\otimes_{A'}A$. The left and right maps to $M$ are $\ell:N\to M$, $n\mapsto\varphi(n\otimes1)$, and $r:M'\to M$, $m'\mapsto m'\otimes1$, regarded as $R$-linear maps by restriction along the two projections $R\to B,A'$ and their common composite to $A$. Define the patched $R$-module to be $P=\{(n,m')\in N\times M':\ell(n)=r(m')\}$ with coordinatewise addition and action $(x,y)(n,m')=(xn,ym')$. In the surjective case $q:A'\twoheadrightarrow A$, with $I=\ker q$, the common reduction $M$ is canonically $M'/IM'$, so this is $N\times_{M'/IM'}M'$ with the quotient map on the right. No flatness, finiteness, nilpotence, Noetherian or nonzero assumption is part of this construction.
